summary: Adds audio material for the model to follow when generating speech, music, timing, or sound design. Seedance 2.5 permits audio-only input; Seedance 2.0, Fast, and Mini require at least one image or video alongside reference audio.
combines: Seedance 2.5: each clip 2–30 s, up to 10 clips, total <= 30 s. Seedance 2.0 series: each clip 2–15 s, up to 3 clips, total <= 15 s.
Each audio file <= 15 MB; request body <= 64 MB.
Seedance 2.5 accepts audio-only input; the 2.0 series does not and requires at least one reference image or video.
All generated audio is mono regardless of input channel count.

2.5 accepts up to 10 audio clips, 2 to 30 seconds each and 30 seconds total, and allows audio-only input. The 2.0 series accepts up to 3, 2 to 15 seconds each and 15 seconds total, and requires an image or video alongside.
